qualified_hardware: MPC Live II + full X-Touch MC/USB
prior_image_acceptance: Earlier images were flashed and booted on the MPC Live II: each upgraded into its own stage, replaced the boot helpers, kept the previous stage and its session files, and ran the controller and the heavy project cleanly. The mouse image was the most recent, flashed over the prior installation with the cursor, click, drag-select and wheel confirmed on the flashed build.
runtime_acceptance: v0.2.2 runtime on the owner's Live II, owner-confirmed 2026-09-16. The v0.2.0 automation-Write freeze is fixed and was verified on hardware: with Write armed, a plugin parameter on a Flip'd fader, mute and solo, a pad parameter, program volume and pan, jog bar/beat, touchscreen contention during a controller burst, and a second insert during automation playback were each driven from the controller without a freeze. Table reclamation was proven in production across many project loads: names and colours held, 2401 requests all settled, no error of any kind, with births served from reclaimed cells rather than failing. The efficiency work was re-tested on the same device: meters fall and stay down after audio decays, and a steady encoder turn with Write off reads back in 10 ms against 50 and sustains 16 to 20 points per second against a previous maximum of 11. Owner reports CPU usage improved and slow volume automation plays back smoothly. Known limit, measured: recorded automation with Write armed still captures about ten points a second, because the application runs a second recording step the value must not precede; the contour is correct and no input is lost. The centre-button Enter and one-press Duplicate Sequence remain built but disabled. A fast wheel spin on some sliders still overshoots.
image_acceptance: v0.2.2: images built and independently decoded to the exact reviewed root; NOT YET flashed or booted on hardware.
